711290101.text: "...The heavens are unfaithful, and those who seek its blessing and gain audience are rare. Fate is capricious, and those whose prosperity endures are few... They who are favored often find their paths barred, and worse awaits those who are not..."

711290102.text: "...This monument was left to ask this of future generations. When you have reached a dead end, what shall you do?"
